source_evidence.finding: BatteryElectrochemicalConfig stores args; get_configs returns argparse.Namespace(**self.configs) without value transformation.
Evaluator saves trained_dataset, overwrites evaluation dataset and CLI model/batch/root/numworkers; not a verbatim checkpoint args evaluation.
PBT route constructs BatteryElectrochemicalConfig -> AutoConfig.from_pretrained optional text model -> BatteryLifeConfig -> PBT.Model.
Published script source requests accelerate mixed_precision bf16. CPU runtime parity not tested.
Inverse transform uses sqrt(label_scaler.var_[-1]) and mean_[-1]. Static scaler values known; code joblib.load remains prohibited.
load_checkpoint_in_model then accelerator.prepare; actual strictness/runtime not executed or certified.
model.eval/no_grad; PBT returns tuple first outputs with DKP and masks, then outputs*std+mean. Official evaluator constructs test loader and is not eligible for current val-only execution.
Forward casts curve/mask/DKP bf16, uses gate, experts, positional encoding, last valid-prefix representation and regression_head. No zero-DKP or precision changes authorized.

root_interpretation_zh: get_configs的源码表达式可静态证明是Namespace逐键传递；没有导入transformers或执行包装器。
已核源码的反归一化公式为y_cycles=y_scaled*765.6855681613043+879.4115308151094，其中sqrt(var)=scale；只固定算术参数，不计算任何预测。
作者发布评估脚本的bf16配置与模型内bfloat16转换一致，但CPU autocast/算子数值等价没有验证，不能据此运行替代精度。
官方evaluate_model.py创建test数据、普通joblib加载并经accelerator加载模型，当前不能直接运行；须单独冻结val-only执行链，不能只改数据名就称隔离完成。
回顾性total-EOL输出尺度已明确；绝对动态剩余循环目标和online origin仍须独立审计。
